title: 2022 AMC 8 Problem 24
statement:
The figure below shows a polygon \(ABCDEFGH,\) consisting of rectangles and right triangles. When cut out and folded on the dotted lines, the polygon forms a triangular prism. Suppose that:

\[ AH = EF = 8 \]

and

\[ GH = 14. \]

What is the volume of the prism?

solutions.text:
When the net is folded, the matching side lengths give \(GF=EF=8\). Since \(GFCB\) is a rectangle, \(BC=8\). The fold identifies \(AB\) with \(BC\), so \(AB=8\). In rectangle \(HJBA\), this gives \(HJ=8\), and the opposite side \(BJ\) equals \(AH=8\).

Since \(GH=14\), we have \(GJ=14-8=6\). Thus one triangular base of the prism is right triangle \(BJG\), with area \[ \frac{6\cdot8}{2}=24. \] The prism length is \(GF=8\), so the volume is \(24\cdot8=192\).

Thus, the correct answer is C.
hints: Find the right-triangle base of the prism
The folded net gives a base with legs \(6\) and \(8\), and prism length \(8\)
